subject: Renewal: evidence concierge & PO pathway for term+capacity top-up
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Patel <anna@helioai.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-12-01T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal: evidence concierge & PO pathway for term+capacity top-up

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per HelioAI's note that you want to renew for a 24‑month term and take a 2x capacity bump, here's the path I recommend so procurement can close quickly:

1) We bundle the evidence package (SOC2 summary, data residency attestation, recent load test results) and link it to a vendor portal record.
2) Helio procurement uploads a PO referencing the SKU and deal id (DL-2029-0458).
3) We issue the SOW amendment (attached SOW_Redwood_HelioAI_v2.pdf) and provide the DocuSign envelope for signatures.

To remove back-and-forth, we've prepared an "evidence concierge" bundle (renewal_evidence_bundle.zip) with the standard attachments plus a short checklist that Procurement can attach to the PO. If it's helpful, Karthik can join a quick 15‑minute session with your procurement team to map fields in your portal to ours.

Next steps: can you confirm the billing contact and preferred PO email? Also, do you require a new vendor onboarding step in your procurement portal (re‑onboard) or can this be a term amendment against the existing vendor record?

Thanks —

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: renewal_evidence_bundle.zip, SOW_Redwood_HelioAI_v2.pdf

From: Anna Patel <anna@helioai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helioai.com
Date: 2029-12-02T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: evidence concierge & PO pathway for term+capacity top-up

Thanks Marcus — this looks good. A few clarifications from Procurement:

- We need vendor recertification since our vendor portal treats a contract term change + capacity increase as a re‑onboard event.
- Billing contact is finance+ap@helioai.com.
- PO will come from procurement@helioai.com and needs the evidence checklist attached.

Procurement asked whether the evidence bundle includes the last SOC2 report or just the attestation summary. They prefer the full report if possible (redacted). Can you provide that in the bundle?

Also, any chance to get a target renewal invoice date (we typically schedule payment ~30 days after signature).

Anna
Head of Partnerships | HelioAI
anna@helioai.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Patel <anna@helioai.com>, procurement@helioai.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-12-03T10:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: evidence concierge & PO pathway for term+capacity top-up

Hi Anna / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick reply. We can include a redacted SOC2 report in the evidence bundle; see vendor-questionnaire-supplement.xlsx (it lists the redaction keys we apply). I've uploaded the redacted report to the evidence bundle and attached the updated zip file.

Invoice cadence: we can issue an invoice on signature with NET30 terms (standard). If you need NET45, note that affects billing approvals — let us know and we'll reflect that in the SOW.

Since your portal treats this as re‑onboard, here's what we'll do to minimize friction:
- Karthik will own the re‑onboarding touchpoint and map the portal fields to Redwood's vendor metadata.
- Lauren will prepare a pre-filled PO template (with SKU and deal id) you can attach directly in your procurement system.
- Marcus will send the DocuSign envelope for the SOW amendment after we confirm PO flow.

I can set up a 20‑minute call tomorrow at 11:00 PT to walk procurement through the checklist and the portal fields. Doable?

Regards,

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: renewal_evidence_bundle.zip (updated), vendor-questionnaire-supplement.xlsx
